notes.title: Version 1.0.13 Update
notes.content:
-Fixed the message at game over.
-Prevented accidental actions on DAY6.

notes.title: Bag fixes and difficulty adjustments
notes.content:
-Added checkpoint to DAY5.
-DAY4 background correction.
-Fixed an issue where the behavior would be strange when pressing a block.

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.content:
Fixed the following
・Freeze when skipping movies
・Losing friends when respawning.
etc.

notes.title: Critical bug fixes
notes.content: ・Fixed a bug that prevented weapon selection on the pause screen.

notes.title: Minor bug fixes. Difficulty adjustment.
notes.content:
・Enhanced jump power when wall jumping
・When teleportation is used, allies are released from standby.
・Grenade trajectory correction
・Fixed bugs
・SE fixes

notes.title: Minor bug fixes, difficulty adjustment
notes.content:
・Fixed the symptom that the manual screen is blurred.
・Fixed the behavior that characters gather and move when teleporting.
・Difficulty adjustment for AREA1-4
・Other minor bug fixes

notes.title: New enemy characters, minor bug fixes, and more
notes.content:
- Change the decision button.
- Added new enemy characters in Area 1-4.
- Fixed text display in UI.
- Move enemy characters near checkpoints.
- Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Fixed minor bugs,Correction of difficulty level
notes.content:
・Fixed minor bugs
・Correction of difficulty level
・When returning to the title on the game over screen, a confirmation screen is displayed.
・A checkpoint has been added in Area 6-1. Adjustment of difficulty level.
・Adjustment of difficulty level in Area1-3.
・Some enemy settings have been changed.
・Fixed flickering when the pause screen is first opened.
・Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Difficulty adjustment
notes.content:
-Made it easier to update some weapons.
-A checkpoint was added to AREA6-2.
